about_intro:
The De Vinci Immersive Lab is a cutting-edge research and innovation facility within the De Vinci Research Center (DVRC) at Pôle Léonard de Vinci. Established to bridge the gap between academic research and industry applications, the lab serves as a collaborative hub where students, researchers, and industry partners explore the frontiers of immersive technologies.

Our mission is to advance the field of Extended Reality (XR) through interdisciplinary research combining computer science, human-computer interaction, cognitive sciences, and creative technologies. We develop innovative solutions in virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and mixed reality (MR) that address real-world challenges in education, healthcare, industry, and entertainment.

The lab is equipped with state-of-the-art hardware including the 4D Space—a dedicated immersive environment featuring motion capture systems, haptic devices, and the latest XR headsets. This unique facility enables researchers to prototype, test, and refine immersive experiences in a professional setting.
about_where_content: Pôle Léonard de Vinci, 12 Avenue Léonard de Vinci, 92400 Courbevoie, Paris La Défense, France
about_when_content: Active since 2020 • Open year-round for research and collaboration
about_axes_content:
• Extended Reality (XR) – VR, AR, MR experiences and interaction design
  • Computer Vision – Object detection, gesture recognition, and visual AI
  • Digital Twins – Real-time simulation and IoT integration
  • Human-Computer Interaction – Ergonomics, user experience, and accessibility
  • AI & Metaverse – Intelligent virtual environments and embodied agents
about_location_content:
• 4D Space – Dedicated immersive prototyping environment
  • Motion Capture Studio – OptiTrack system for precise tracking
  • XR Device Library – Meta Quest 3, HTC Vive Pro, Microsoft HoloLens, and more
  • GPU Workstations – High-performance NVIDIA-powered machines for real-time rendering
  • Collaboration Spaces – Meeting rooms equipped for hybrid demos
about_custom_1_text:
The De Vinci Immersive Lab brings together a multidisciplinary team of researchers, engineers, and designers from three prestigious schools: ESILV (Engineering), EMLV (Business), and IIM (Digital & Creative Technologies). Our faculty members are internationally recognized experts in their fields, publishing regularly in top-tier conferences such as IEEE VR, CHI, and SIGGRAPH. We actively collaborate with industry partners including major XR hardware manufacturers, creative studios, and enterprise clients seeking innovative training and visualization solutions. Key Research Leads:
  • Dr. Xiao Xiao – Director, Creative Technologies & Embodied Interaction
  • Ahmed Azough – Human-Computer Interaction & XR Development
  • Insaf Khelladi – Consumer Behavior & Mixed-Reality Retail
  • Prof. Francesco Salvarani – Director of Research, ESILV
about_custom_2_text:
We welcome collaboration opportunities with academic institutions, startups, and established enterprises. Whether you're looking to conduct joint research, develop innovative prototypes, or train your teams with immersive technologies, the De Vinci Immersive Lab offers the expertise and facilities to bring your vision to life. Partnership Opportunities:
  • Joint research projects and publications
  • Student internships and final-year projects
  • Custom XR development and consulting
  • Workshops and professional training programs
  • Access to our annual DIVE workshop and De Vinci Festival showcases
Contact us: Ahmed.azough@devinci.fr
